items.quote: After a real HippoRAG ingest (chunk-embed writes), a query on the normal PPR path (fact-filter keeps at least one fact) returns items whose ids resolve
reset-vector-join's passage weights are keyed by the same strings as the graph's chunk vertex names, so ppr seeds each passage vertex whose chunk scored against the query with a non-zero reset weight
When any node of an ingest wiring fails, Engine.ingest commits none of the staged writes: every store's drop_pending_index_ops runs instead of index_done_callback
A HippoRAG ingest refusal carries the real exception of the node that failed (e.g. ClientNotWiredError naming 'embedding' when chunk-embed has no embedding client)
The fact-filter node receives the query text: fact-filter is listed in consumes_query of wirings/hipporag/base.json
Every chunk produced by chunk-embed gets a passage vertex in the HippoRAG graph after ingest, including chunks for which OpenIE extracted no triples
synonymy-edges matches the entities new in the current ingest against all entities, both those committed by earlier ingests and those staged by entity-fact-embed in the same run.
HippoRAG edge weights and edge_types accumulate across ingests: a co-occurrence edge produced by two separate ingests has the summed co-occurrence weight
A fact extracted from different documents in separate ingests keeps the union of chunk_ids in both its fact vector metadata and its KV 'fact:<id>' record
OpenIE extraction failures are reported: malformed NER or triple JSON responses and per-chunk chat() exceptions are counted per chunk and returned in the ingest outcome (and trace)
